title: Dance & Yoga Studio Software Compared (2026)
description: Mindbody, Zen Planner and Gymdesk compared for dance and yoga studios: published starting prices, booking, users and payment fees.
h1: Software for dance and yoga studios
body:
Dance and yoga studios care more about class booking, class packs and drop-ins than belt ranks. Here are the published facts for three widely used platforms.

{{table:mindbody,zen-planner,gymdesk}}

Mindbody

From $79/mo per location with unlimited users, plus a listing on the Mindbody consumer app. New clients who come through the app carry a 20% fee on their first purchase, capped at $30. {{aff:mindbody|Visit Mindbody}}

Zen Planner

From $99/mo, scaled by active members; online scheduling and a member app included. {{aff:zenplanner|Visit Zen Planner}}

Gymdesk

From $75/mo with Gymdesk Payments, with a website included. {{aff:gymdesk|Visit Gymdesk}}

Mariana Tek

Built for boutique fitness studios (pilates, yoga, barre, cycling) with a custom-branded app on every plan. Prices are not published; see our Mariana Tek overview. {{aff:marianatek|Visit Mariana Tek}}

Dance-specific tools (Jackrabbit Class, DanceStudio-Pro and others) are on our backlog. Related: martial arts software · yoga tools · dance tools
faq: Does Mindbody charge per staff member?
No. Mindbody says all plans include unlimited users per location (mindbodyonline.com/business/pricing).
How much does dance studio software cost?

Published starting prices: Gymdesk $75/mo with Gymdesk Payments (up to 50 active members) or $100/mo with your own processor, Mindbody from $79/mo per location (Starter), and Zen Planner from $99/mo (Studio).
Can dance students book classes online?
Yes. Mindbody lists self-serve booking, Zen Planner lists online scheduling, and Gymdesk lets members book classes from their phone.
Does Gymdesk offer a free trial?
Yes. Gymdesk offers a 30-day free trial with no credit card.
